name: Example Thermal Comfort Project
description: Thermal comfort analysis with the Comfort backend (built on EnergyPlus), based on the FZK-Haus IFC. Adds exterior window shading and renames plot keys for cleaner result plots. IFC path should be updated to match your local repository location.
notes: Based on examples/e1_simple_project_comfort_energyplus.py. The Comfort backend builds on EnergyPlus, so it inherits all EnergyPlus settings (including run_full_simulation and ep_install_path, see Advanced Settings) plus its own comfort-specific settings such as rename_plot_keys and prj_use_conditions (which defaults to a comfort-specific UseConditions.json bundled with the plugin).
